title: The Matriarch
html:
The flock that came down to Gregor's road answers to one bird on the Willow Downs cliff. Ossa wants her taken off it before the whole flock settles on Wispmeyer for good.

About

Given byOssa Penhallow
Level34
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points3

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Ossa Penhallow (outdoors near Trollbarrow) to get the quest.
  2. Reach the nesting cliff on Willow Downs at 1072, -617
  3. Kill the Matriarch at 1079, -616
  4. Report back to Ossa Penhallow at 1186, -350

Rewards

Reward
Gold1,360
Character XP59,500
Quest points3
ItemsMatriarch Crest
Choose oneGold Spikedhelm
or Gold Shield

What Ossa Penhallow says

Ossa Penhallow: They went north. All of them, inside a day.

Ossa Penhallow: The down's as quiet as it was when I was a girl.

You: Gregor will say it was the road.

Ossa Penhallow: He'll get his wagons and he'll tell everyone the road was the problem, and I'm going to let him. A man that age should get to be right about something.

Ossa Penhallow: The bog is still coming. My stakes are still in the ground and I'll keep walking out to them.

Ossa Penhallow: But that's next year's argument. Take the crest. She earned it, and now you have.

Handing it in

"Take the crest. She earned it, and now you have."

The Matriarch
